name: inline-list
title: Inline list
description: Meta lines whose separators never dangle: a byline wraps without a dot at the start or end of a line.
docs: The items are the children, and anything empty (null, false) is skipped, so a conditional item leaves no stray separator. separator is dot (the default), slash, pipe or none; gap is sm, md, lg or a length, measured in the type size; align is start, center or end; size is xs, sm or md; as is div (plain text) or ul (a list, whose separators are hidden from assistive technology). Each item stays on one line unless you pass nowrap={false}, so a break only ever happens between items. The separator is a shape painted behind the space between two items, which the browser removes where a line breaks, so one never starts a line or ends one, in any alignment, and there is no script.
